scoring_justification: Band gaps and Fe-N-O angle are recomputed from the raw CSV/JSON artifacts; no self-reported scalars are trusted.

hidden_assets.purpose: FeTP band gap threshold: gap <= 0.1 eV confirms metallic character; derived from paper's statement that a majority-spin band crosses the Fermi level.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Threshold based on typical DFT metallic gap tolerance
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Agrees with paper's metallic claim; a correct reproduction will show a crossing band -> gap effectively zero.

hidden_assets.purpose: FeTP-NO band gap threshold: gap >= 0.2 eV confirms insulating gap after NO adsorption; derived from paper's Fig. 4 showing an opened band gap.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Threshold chosen to distinguish insulating gap (>0.2 eV) while accommodating small method variations
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Matches the paper's claim of an energy gap opening; a correct reproduction will have a gap >0.2 eV.

hidden_assets.purpose: Fe-N-O angle target 148° ± 5°; from paper stating the angle is about 148°.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper abstract and geometry optimization results
hidden_assets.generation_method: Target value taken directly from paper; tolerance ±5° allows for DFT code differences while still matching the experimental/paper range.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Exact paper-reported value and typical angular tolerance for geometry optimization.

schema.description: CSV file with column 'k_coord' (float, units 1/Å) and additional columns for band energies (float, eV), one per band/spin channel. Fermi level is at zero.

outputs.description: Raw band structure of bare FeTP. The checker recomputes the band gap from this file.

schema.description: Same format as feTP_band.csv, but for the FeTP-NO system.

outputs.description: Raw band structure of FeTP-NO. The checker recomputes the band gap.
Fe-N-O bond angle from the optimized FeTP-NO geometry.

output_contract.notes: All band energies assume the Fermi level set to zero. The checker computes the smallest gap between conduction and valence bands for each system. The Fe-N-O angle is compared against a hidden tolerance window.

steps.description: Recomputed FeTP band gap (eV). Metallic when <= 0.1 eV.
Recomputed FeTP-NO band gap (eV). Insulating when >= 0.2 eV.
